text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening before a race, I find Taiki
Shuttle
running on the track.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The gates are open. Three, two, one...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: On your mark, get set...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She takes off running on her own signal,
giving no
indication that she heard me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki runs in fits and starts, with some

deliberating in between. She does this
several
times with intense concentration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take a seat and observe her for a while.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew... Time's up already? Darn it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well, look who it is! Howdy,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Were ya watchin' me just now? Why
didn't ya say
anything?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my bad! It was supposed to be a
light run, but
I got carried away!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Running is just so fun, it's hard to stop!
Wanna
join me for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Workin' up a good sweat is a surefire
way to
revitalize yourself! And food
always tastes better
afterward too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna get in trouble if you're
with me!
choice_data_list: It's already time to head home.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's around this late, so it's the
perfect time
to cut loose!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Please, Trainer? I wanna keep goin'.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That race is why I gotta run.
choice_data_list: Maybe you should rest up for the race...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is a winner's outfit. It represents my
grit and
gumption to win.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When I wear it, my heart and body get
the
shakes, and I wanna shout for
everybody to
hear...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "I ain't gonna lose—no way, no how!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's 'cause you've gone and
toughened me
up, Trainer. Now I'm
gettin' greedy for victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose now! You gotta take
responsibility for
this feeling!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose now! You gotta take
responsibility for
this feeling!
choice_data_list: If it's just a little bit longer...
Don't worry, I'll definitely lead you to victory!
Don't worry, I'll definitely lead you to victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?! Yahoo!
choice_data_list: If it's just a little bit longer...
Don't worry, I'll definitely lead you to victory!
Don't worry, I'll definitely lead you to victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's already so dark out... but that's not
gonna
stop me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sounds like a promise! Thank ya, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hm... How 'bout I make a promise of my
own?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll always win. I won't lose, no
matter
who I'm up against.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep rackin' up victories till I make it
to the
top! So let's make sure we're
locked and loaded,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and I vow to reach the top
together.
